transcript.content:
A user has filed a support ticket reporting that their experience
with the service has degraded — requests feel slow or are failing
for them. The on-call team needs you to investigate.

Telemetry parquets are stored in: `.`
Available files: abnormal_metrics.parquet, abnormal_traces.parquet,
abnormal_logs.parquet, abnormal_metrics_histogram.parquet,
abnormal_metrics_sum.parquet, normal_metrics.parquet,
normal_traces.parquet, normal_logs.parquet.

Walk the telemetry to identify which endpoints / services are
actually affected, then determine the root cause(s) of the
degradation.

content.text: Let me compare per-service span stats between the normal and abnormal periods.

input.query: SELECT 'normal' p, service_name, attr_span_kind k, count(*) n, avg(duration)/1e6 avg_ms, quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6 p95_ms, avg(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='Error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) err FROM normal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3 UNION ALL SELECT 'abnormal', service_name, attr_span_kind, count(*), avg(duration)/1e6, quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6, avg(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='Error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,3,1

input.query: SELECT service_name, attr_span_kind k, sum(CASE WHEN src='n' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_norm, sum(CASE WHEN src='a' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_abn, round(avg(CASE WHEN src='n' THEN duration END)/1e6,2) avg_norm, round(avg(CASE WHEN src='a' THEN duration END)/1e6,2) avg_abn, round(avg(CASE WHEN src='n' AND attr_status_code='Error' THEN 1.0 WHEN src='n' THEN 0 END),3) err_n, round(avg(CASE WHEN src='a' AND attr_status_code='Error' THEN 1.0 WHEN src='a' THEN 0 END),3) err_a FROM (SELECT 'n' src, * FROM normal_traces UNION ALL SELECT 'a', * FROM abnormal_traces) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT service_name, attr_k8s_pod_name pod, attr_span_kind k, span_name, count(*) n, round(avg(duration)/1e6,1) avg_ms, round(max(duration)/1e6,1) max_ms FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name IN ('ts-route-service','ts-route-plan-service','ts-travel-plan-service','ts-basic-service','ts-travel-service','ts-ui-dashboard') GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT metric, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT service_name) svcs, round(avg(value),2) avg_v FROM abnormal_metrics GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT 'a' src, service_name, level, attr_log_template, count(*) n FROM abnormal_logs WHERE level <> 'INFO' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT service_name, attr_k8s_pod_name pod, metric, round(min(value),1) mn, round(max(value),1) mx, count(*) n FROM abnormal_metrics_sum WHERE metric IN ('k8s.pod.uptime') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY mn ASC LIMIT 15

input.query: SELECT 'a' src, service_name, metric, round(avg(value),3) avg_v, round(max(value),3) max_v FROM abnormal_metrics WHERE service_name IN ('ts-route-service','ts-travel-plan-service','ts-route-plan-service') AND metric IN ('container.cpu.usage','container.memory.working_set','k8s.pod.cpu_limit_utilization','k8s.pod.memory_limit_utilization') GROUP BY 1,2,3 UNION ALL SELECT 'n', service_name, metric, round(avg(value),3), round(max(value),3) FROM normal_metrics WHERE service_name IN ('ts-route-service','ts-travel-plan-service','ts-route-plan-service') AND metric IN ('container.cpu.usage','container.memory.working_set','k8s.pod.cpu_limit_utilization','k8s.pod.memory_limit_utilization') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,3,1

SELECT p.service_name caller, c.service_name callee, c.span_name, count(*) n, round(avg(p.duration)/1e6,1) caller_client_ms, round(avg(c.duration)/1e6,1) callee_server_ms FROM abnormal_traces p JOIN abnormal_traces c ON c.parent_span_id = p.span_id AND c.trace_id = p.trace_id WHERE p.attr_span_kind='Client' AND c.attr_span_kind='Server' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT c.service_name, c.span_name, c.attr_span_kind, c.attr_status_code, round(c.duration/1e6,1) ms, c.attr_http_response_status_code code FROM abnormal_traces p JOIN abnormal_traces c ON c.trace_id = p.trace_id AND c.parent_span_id = p.span_id WHERE p.span_name LIKE 'GET /api/v1/foodservice%' OR (p.span_name LIKE 'GET /api/v1/routeservice/routes' AND p.service_name='ts-ui-dashboard') LIMIT 30

SELECT 'n' src, span_name, count(*) n, round(avg(duration)/1e6,2) avg_ms, round(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,2) p95_ms FROM normal_traces WHERE service_name='ts-route-service' AND attr_span_kind='Client' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'a', span_name, count(*), round(avg(duration)/1e6,2), round(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,2) FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name='ts-route-service' AND attr_span_kind='Client' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1
